cloudwatch_dashboard.description: Dashboard used to monitor prediction behavior, model confidence, and feature drift.

cloudwatch_alarms.description: Alarms monitor low model confidence and significant feature drift.

endpoint_monitoring_note: This project deploys the model using SageMaker Batch Transform rather than a persistent real-time endpoint. Therefore, infrastructure monitoring focuses on batch job status, CloudWatch logs, CloudWatch metrics, dashboards, and alarms instead of endpoint latency or invocation errors.
summary: Infrastructure monitoring is implemented through SageMaker job tracking and CloudWatch observability resources. This provides visibility into the health of training, batch inference, prediction logging, custom metrics, dashboards, and alarms.
